# skycloak_cluster (Resource)

A Skycloak managed Keycloak cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "skycloak_cluster" "production" {
  name     = "production"
  type     = "keycloak"
  size     = "small"
  version  = "26.1"
  # One of us (US East), us-west (US West), ca, eu, au.
  location = "eu"

  # Optional: a site of the location, such as one with Azure private link.
  # Leave it out for the location's default site. Changing it replaces the cluster.
  # site = "azure-north-europe"
}

output "cluster_url" {
  value = skycloak_cluster.production.url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `location` (String) Region (`us` for US East, `us-west` for US West, `ca`, `eu`, `au`). Immutable: changing it replaces the cluster. The one exception is a cluster the API reports as `us-west`: switching its configuration between `us` and `us-west` is applied in place, because both name the same cluster.
- `name` (String) Human-readable cluster name.
- `size` (String) Instance size (`small`, `medium`, `large`).
- `type` (String) Cluster type (`keycloak` or `tidecloak`). Immutable — changing it replaces the cluster.
- `version` (String) Keycloak version, e.g. `26.1`. A version lower than the one the cluster runs is refused at plan time, because a Keycloak version cannot be downgraded. This includes a cluster that automatic upgrades moved above the configured version: set the version to the current one or higher.

### Optional

- `auto_upgrade_enabled` (Boolean) Enable automatic patch upgrades, applied inside the cluster's maintenance window. Defaults to `false`.
- `site` (String) Site hosting the cluster, a code such as `us-east`. Leave it out to use the location's default site; the site the cluster landed on is then read back. Only sites your workspace has been granted can be used. Immutable: changing it replaces the cluster.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Cluster ID (UUID).
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status (`provisioning`, `available`, ...).
- `url` (String) Cluster base URL once available.
